sources.cite: CompTIA Cloud+ CV0-004 (V4) certification page: Cloud architecture 23%, Deployment 19%, Security 19%, Operations 17%, Troubleshooting 12%, DevOps fundamentals 10%
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of CompTIA's page. Relevant text: billing management and resource optimization for cost under Cloud architecture; identity and access management under Security; backup and recovery under Operations; diagnosing deployment problems under Troubleshooting. The objective wording here is the course seed's. Cloud+ is vendor-neutral: these cases are set on one provider, as worked examples.

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Cloud Run: Rollbacks, gradual rollouts, and traffic migration (last updated 2026-11-10)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: roll back with 'gcloud run services update-traffic SERVICE --to-revisions REVISION=100'; 'Rolling back traffic to a revision updates the routing configuration immediately'; deploy with 'gcloud run deploy --image IMAGE --no-traffic' then shift traffic in steps, for example 5 percent; '--no-traffic --tag TAG_NAME' lets you 'directly test the new revision at a specific URL, without serving traffic'; 'the percentages must add up to 100'; 'traffic routing adjustments are not instantaneous'.
